maria_infra: Quick signal — our hosted API demand curve in us-west just shifted up. If current 14-day trend holds we hit committed GPU cap (~480 A100-equivalents) in 8–10 days. Not a hard outage yet but margin < 6%.

alex_capacity: Oof. Is this organic growth or a specific customer/job pattern?

maria_infra: Mostly organic — three small customers on bulk-embed jobs increased batching, and the new 4k-context LLM rollout increased average token length by ~18%.

sam_oncall: Any billing anomalies tied to this? Could be double-counted preemptible usage or SKU mismatch.

ryan_fin: I pulled the last week's invoice export — noticed some charges mapped to "ReservedGPU:other" instead of region-specific SKUs which inflates apparent committed usage on paper. Will share query.

capacity-bot: Automated alert — reservation_headroom(us-west) = 5.3% | projected_exhaustion_ts = 2923464321 | recommended_action = "review-burst-credits or add-commitment"

maria_infra: Ryan — can you paste the BigQuery you used? We'll sanity-check mapping against runtime labels.

ryan_fin: Sure — here's the snippet I ran in billing:```sql
SELECT invoice_month, sku_id, sku_description, SUM(cost) as cost_usd
FROM `company_billing.invoice_line_items`
WHERE invoice_month = FORMAT_DATE("%Y-%m", DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH))
  AND sku_description LIKE '%GPU%'
GROUP BY invoice_month, sku_id, sku_description
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC
```

ryan_fin: The hit was a handful of large embed jobs that ended up on a cheaper preemptible pool overnight but were billed under a "shared-reserved" SKU due to an infra tagging edge-case. That masks the region-level reservation use in our forecasting model.

alex_capacity: OK — two threads then: (1) fix tagging so forecast reflects actual reservation draw, (2) short-term hedges. For hedges I'd prefer avoid manual cloud commitment purchases. Can we spin up an interim dedicated pool (on Dedicated product) or shift some low-SLO embed jobs to a cheaper GPU family?

tanya_sre: Low-SLO jobs can go to a mixed pool with relaxed latency SLO and smaller batch windows. Also suggest throttling per-customer bulk embed concurrency by token/sec so we don't tank latencies for everyone.

maria_infra: Agreed. Immediate actions: throttle embed concurrency for the three offending customers to 60% of current, enable the fallback routing rule to cheaper variant (gpt-embed-3-small) for requests > 2M tokens/day, and patch billing labels.

sam_oncall: I'll open a short runbook for the throttle to make it reversible. Patch idea: we change router policy to `prefer_reserve=false` for those customers. Sample CLI:```bash
# switch routing weight to cheaper variant
redwoodctl routing set-weight --customer=acct-1234 --model=gpt-embed-3-small --weight=0.6
```

maria_infra: Ryan — can you confirm if we have unused committed credits in other regions we can borrow? If not, I want a vendor negotiation thread to buy a small add-on commitment in us-west for 3 months (fast ramp).

ryan_fin: There's ~20 A100-eq idle in eu-west commitments showing as spare today. Cross-region transfer isn't straightforward with current vendor contract, but we can request a temporary reallocation. I'll ping vendor and estimate cost of a 30-day add-on.

alex_capacity: If vendor add-on is >20% of expected incremental cost, do the software hedges first. Also, add a quick dashboard panel to surface reservation headroom per model-family (embed vs gen) so we don't mix signals.

capacity-bot: New task created: TICKET-7753 "us-west reservation headroom dashboard" assigned to alex_capacity — due 3d.

maria_infra: Action items summary: 1) sam_oncall — create reversible throttle runbook (ETA 2h), 2) ryan_fin — vendor realloc/add-on inquiry + fix billing labels (ETA 6h), 3) alex_capacity — headroom dashboard + routing-weight change in canary (ETA 1d), 4) tanya_sre — configure mixed low-SLO pool and routing fallback (ETA 12h).

tanya_sre: I'll also add a quick smoke test to the rollout that asserts embed latency stays within 2x baseline for fallback model.

maria_infra: Thanks team. If the vendor comes back slow we'll execute throttles and fallback tonight. Ping here when you have numbers. :dizzy_face:
